quakes.label: Earthquakes
quakes.says: Feed page: "Updated every minute." Response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
quakes.licence: USGS Copyrights and Credits page: "USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain"; credit is requested.

events.label: Storms, floods, fires and volcanoes
events.source: GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System)
events.says: Feed reference page: its popular feeds are "updated every 6 minutes". The cadence of the API we call is not stated on the page.
events.licence: Terms of use page: a disclaimer only (results are model output, "may require further validation", "should not be used for decision making" alone). A reuse licence is not stated on the page.

aurora.label: Aurora forecast
aurora.says: Product page: "a 30 to 90 minute forecast". The refresh interval is not stated on the page; response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
aurora.licence: Not stated on the pages read.
aurora.credit: Aurora: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

kp.label: Geomagnetic activity (Kp)
kp.says: The refresh interval is not stated on the page; response headers: cache-control max-age=60.
kp.licence: Not stated on the pages read.
kp.credit: Kp: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center

spaceweather.label: Solar wind and geomagnetic alerts
spaceweather.says: Rows are one minute apart. Response headers measured 2026-10-04 on rtsw_mag_1m.json and alerts.json: cache-control max-age=60. The page read does not state a refresh interval.
spaceweather.licence: NWS disclaimer page (weather.gov/disclaimer): NWS web page information is "in the public domain, unless specifically noted otherwise" and may be used if you do not claim it is your own, imply NOAA/NWS endorsement, or modify it and present it as official.
spaceweather.credit: Solar wind and alerts: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
spaceweather.note: 10 geomagnetic messages in the last 72 h

storms.label: Tropical storms (Atlantic and Pacific)
storms.says: The GIS page lists the feeds. Response headers measured 2026-10-04: cache-control max-age=300. Advisories come about every six hours. Its KML says the official forecast track in KML format is an experimental product.
storms.licence: NWS disclaimer page: public domain with the three conditions quoted for the space weather feed.

fires.label: Active fire detections
fires.says: The LANCE page says near real-time users usually need data "within three hours"; the FIRMS pages themselves returned no text when read, so the latency for fire files is not confirmed from a primary page. Measured 2026-10-04: the 24 hour files were last modified within an hour of the request.
fires.licence: LANCE page: "NASA supports full and open sharing of data"; third parties are asked to acknowledge LANCE (text in the credit below); the information is provided "as is".

closeapproaches.label: Asteroid close approaches
closeapproaches.says: The page describes "current close-approach data" and sets its defaults to "NEO Earth close-approaches less than 0.05 au in the next 60 days sorted by date". It states no refresh interval; every 6 hours is our choice. It asks users to check the payload's signature version (we require 1.5).
closeapproaches.licence: Not stated on the page read.

launches.label: Rocket launches
launches.says: The Space Devs FAQ: free access to Launch Library 2 is "limited to 15 calls per hour" and users are "heavily" encouraged to cache the output and avoid having user clients query the APIs directly. The API's api-throttle endpoint reported 15 requests per 3600 seconds on 2026-10-05. It states no refresh interval for the data; once an hour is our choice and uses a quarter of the allowance. The detailed answer (about 1 MB for 30 launches on 2026-10-05) is used because only it carries the webcast links (vid_urls); each link has a type such as "Official Webcast" or "Unofficial Re-stream" and a publisher, and 2 of the 30 launches had any link.
launches.licence: The Space Devs FAQ terms of use: "You are free to use the data in any way, shape, or form"; accuracy of all the information is not guaranteed; "Attribution is not mandatory, but is encouraged and appreciated". Images carry their own licences (some are non-commercial), so none are used.
launches.note: next: Long March 8A | Unknown Payload at 2026-10-25T01:50:00Z

clouds.label: Cloud forecast
clouds.says: Terms: "don't repeat requests until the time indicated in the Expires response header" and use If-Modified-Since. Measured: Expires about 30 minutes after the request.
clouds.licence: Attribution required as in CC BY 4.0; requests must identify the application in the User-Agent; browsers "should not contact the API directly".

planes.label: Aircraft
planes.says: Refresh interval and rate limits are not stated on the pages read.
planes.licence: Pages read: "License: ODbL 1.0". Its attribution and share-alike conditions need reading before a public launch.

satellites.label: Satellite orbits
satellites.says: Usage policy: "For GP data, updates are once every 2 hours." Stop at the first non-200 answer and tell a human; repeating gets the address firewalled.
satellites.licence: Usage policy page read; it asks users to follow it and to cache. No licence text on that page.
satellites.note: 286 exact orbits, 244 launched in the last 30 days, median element age 10.7 h

catalogue.label: Satellite catalogue
catalogue.says: The catalogue refresh interval is not stated on the pages read. Larger lists are rate limited, so this is fetched once a day.
catalogue.licence: Usage policy page read; no licence text on that page.

satcat.label: Whole satellite catalogue, counted by owner
satcat.says: Usage policy: "The SATCAT updates manually once or twice a day." It asks to download data once per update and to stop at the first non-200 answer, so this is fetched once a day. The CSV was 6,764,885 bytes on 2026-10-07.
satcat.licence: Usage policy page read; no licence text on that page. Whether derived counts and per-object details may be republished is NOT CONFIRMED.
satcat.note: 35057 objects in Earth orbit, 130 owners, 51 owner files

static.label: Stars and constellation lines
static.note: Fixed catalogue packed at build time (Hipparcos based). Non-commercial licence, see docs/feature-sources.md.

static.label: Coastlines
static.note: Natural Earth outlines via world-atlas, packed at build time.

static.label: Earth, Moon and cloud images
static.note: Packed at build time. The cloud image is a daily NASA GIBS composite from the build day and is not refreshed by this pipeline yet.

static.label: Flight routes and airlines
static.note: Looked up once at build time from adsb.lol and OpenFlights. The route endpoint is marked deprecated, so this is not refreshed.

static.label: Shaking maps and population exposure
static.note: Fetched once at build time for the largest quakes from USGS ShakeMap and PAGER. New quakes show no shaking map until this is made live.
